note: #2767 item 3 (terminal-punctuation short-circuit only treats a period as a self-containment signal): `findClosingQuoteIndex` never existed under that name in this repo's history. Today's SENTENCE_TERMINATOR_PATTERN treats ".", "!", and "?" identically in both the backward and forward framing-verb scans (verified with matched .-/!-/?-terminated triples in both directions giving identical results).
